questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs mean an action is forbidden. This sign tells you that you are driving the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and prevent brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery. Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas stations, hospitals, and other services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around if you are facing this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic travels in both directions on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to watch for cyclists, pedestrians, and other hazards that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with busy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. Speed advisory signs show the recommended speed for the upcoming condition.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a fork in the road where you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of hazards in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a winding road. Reduce your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This lane control sign tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you must go left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot turn right at this location. You must follow all traffic laws indicated by regulatory signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you must drive only in the direction the arrow points. This is a traffic law you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Stop at the marked line if it exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that bicycles may be crossing this area. Stay alert for cyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand signals because bikes have no turn signals. A left arm straight out signals a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.
